description: This file defines a set of classes and functions for adapting and transforming between different language model formats, specifically for Google GenAI integration. It provides stream wrappers, format translation, and message handling to convert and manipulate responses and requests between litellm and Google GenAI formats.

classes.name: GoogleGenAIStreamWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for handling streaming responses from Google GenAI, transforming chunks, and accumulating tool call data as they stream.

classes.name: GoogleGenAIAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class responsible for translating requests and responses between litellm's internal format and Google GenAI's expected format, including message and content transformation functions.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] translate_generate_content_to_completion( self, model: str, contents: Union[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]], config: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms a Google GenAI generate_content request into litellm's completion dictionary format.

methods.name: dict _add_generic_litellm_params_to_request( self, completion_request_dict: Dict[str, Any], litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] = None, )
methods.description: Adds generic litellm parameters such as api base, key, version, etc., to the completion request dictionary.

methods.name: Union[AsyncIterator[bytes],None] translate_completion_output_params_streaming( self, completion_stream: Any, )
methods.description: Wraps a litellm streaming completion response to Google GenAI format as server-sent events.

methods.name: List[ChatCompletionToolParam] _transform_google_genai_tools_to_openai( self, tools: List[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Converts Google GenAI tools schema to OpenAI compatible tool parameters.

methods.name: Optional[ChatCompletionToolChoiceValues] _transform_google_genai_tool_config_to_openai( self, tool_config: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Transforms Google GenAI tool configuration to OpenAI's tool choice format.

methods.name: List[AllMessageValues] _transform_contents_to_messages( self, contents: List[Dict[str, Any]], system_instruction: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Converts Google GenAI contents to OpenAI message format, handling system instructions, user, and assistant roles with special handling for function responses and calls.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] translate_completion_to_generate_content( self, response: ModelResponse, )
methods.description: Converts litellm completion responses into Google GenAI generate_content response format, including handling message parts and finish reasons.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] translate_streaming_completion_to_generate_content( self, response: Union[ModelResponse, ModelResponseStream], wrapper: GoogleGenAIStreamWrapper, )
methods.description: Transforms incremental streaming chunks from litellm into Google GenAI streaming responses, accumulating partial tool calls across chunks.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _transform_openai_message_to_google_genai_parts( self, message: Any, )
methods.description: Converts an OpenAI message object to Google GenAI parts, including text and function call representations.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _transform_openai_delta_to_google_genai_parts_with_accumulation( self, delta: Any, wrapper: GoogleGenAIStreamWrapper )
methods.description: Processes a delta chunk of streaming data, accumulating tool call parts based on index, and handling incomplete JSON arguments during streaming.

methods.name: str _map_finish_reason(self, finish_reason: Optional[str])
methods.description: Maps OpenAI finish reasons to Google GenAI finish reasons.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] _map_usage(self, usage: Any)
methods.description: Converts OpenAI usage metrics to Google GenAI usage format.
